title: Progress 92 Cargo Spacecraft Docks To Space Station – Saturday, July 5, 2025
description: The uncrewed Roscosmos ISS Progress 92 cargo spacecraft docked to the Poisk module July 5 after launching to the International Space Station from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan July 3 on a Soyuz booster rocket. Progress is filled with nearly three tons of supplies and cargo and will remain docked to the space station for approximately six months.  Join NASA as we go forward to the Moon and on to Mars -- discover the latest on Earth, the Solar System and beyond with a weekly update in your inbox.  Subscribe at: https://www.nasa.gov/subscribe
keywords: Expedition 73, Progress 92 Cargo Spacecraft Docks to Space Station
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
